title: Seasonality & Peak Times
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Busiest weekday and hour
kpis.sql: SELECT dayname(o.order_ts) || ' ' || lpad(hour(o.order_ts)::VARCHAR, 2, '0') FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Busiest month of the year
kpis.sql: SELECT month(o.order_ts) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: November against an average month, 2025
kpis.sql: SELECT round((SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE year(o.order_ts) = 2025 AND month(o.order_ts) = 11) * 12.0 / (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE year(o.order_ts) = 2025), 2)

kpis.label: Orders on the 25th-27th against the daily average
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * avg(d.n / a.avg_n), 2) FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS m, day(o.order_ts) AS dd, count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true GROUP BY 1, 2) d JOIN (SELECT m, avg(n) AS avg_n FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS m, day(o.order_ts) AS dd, count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true GROUP BY 1, 2) GROUP BY 1) a USING (m) WHERE d.dd BETWEEN 25 AND 27

kpis.label: Busiest weekday and hour
kpis.sql: SELECT dayname(o.order_ts) || ' ' || lpad(hour(o.order_ts)::VARCHAR, 2, '0') FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true AND o.channel = 'sales_rep' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Busiest month of the year
kpis.sql: SELECT month(o.order_ts) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true AND o.channel = 'sales_rep' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: November against an average month, 2025
kpis.sql: SELECT round((SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE year(o.order_ts) = 2025 AND month(o.order_ts) = 11 AND o.channel = 'sales_rep') * 12.0 / (SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE year(o.order_ts) = 2025 AND o.channel = 'sales_rep'), 2)

kpis.label: Orders on the 25th-27th against the daily average
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * avg(d.n / a.avg_n), 2) FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS m, day(o.order_ts) AS dd, count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true AND o.channel = 'sales_rep' GROUP BY 1, 2) d JOIN (SELECT m, avg(n) AS avg_n FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS m, day(o.order_ts) AS dd, count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true AND o.channel = 'sales_rep' GROUP BY 1, 2) GROUP BY 1) a USING (m) WHERE d.dd BETWEEN 25 AND 27

density.bucket: weekday x hour cell, on average
density.rule: a weekday x hour heatmap needs 50 per cell on average (night cells may be low)
density.sql: SELECT round(count(*) / 168.0, 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true

density.bucket: day of the month, over the 33 months
density.rule: an average per day of the month needs 500 orders in each day's total
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE true AND day(o.order_ts) <= 28 GROUP BY day(o.order_ts))
